messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Elevated 429/503 rates detected on /v1/embeddings since ~1768801200. 429 rate at 18% (5m avg), 503 at 3.1%. Deck: https://grafana.redwood/embeddings/errors -> dash panels + heatmap. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.
Samir Patel: I'm taking lead. tagging @jen. quick triage: is this traffic skewed to a tenant or global?
Jen Lee: On it. opening the graph -> looks like a strong spike from eu-west region and concentrated on the embeddings route. Top client keys show a few tenants spike (acme-corp, streamly). digging logs now.
Lia Chen: I can apply tenant-level limits quickly. recommend soft-throttle noisy tenants first, then global shed if still bad.
Morty SRE: Any recent deploys to embedding service? CI shows no production deploys in last 40m.
Samir Patel: good — reduces blast radius candidate. Jen, can you confirm request sizes? maybe a batch job started.
Jen Lee: Logs show high concurrency from a handful of API keys; payload sizes normal. probable misconfigured batched ingestion hitting public API. pushing a sample request id -> `req_1768801289` to #eng-logs.
Mike O'Connor: I'm drafting customer outreach in case we need to notify. hold on message here and I'll paste.
Lia Chen: Applying immediate per-tenant throttle for the top offenders.
Lia Chen: ```sh
# quick mitigation: limit noisy tenants to 20 rps
rwctl tenant update --id acme-corp --max-rps 20 --reason "live 429/503 mitigation"
rwctl tenant update --id streamly --max-rps 15 --reason "live 429/503 mitigation"
``` 
Lia Chen: applied. confirmation from control-plane: tenant throttle rules active (rule ids: rt-342, rt-343).
Jen Lee: After tenant throttles: 429 dropped to ~9% in eu-west, 503 to 1.6%. trending down but still above baseline.
Morty SRE: Turning on short global circuit for non-critical endpoints (embedding-preview) to reduce load on shared workers.
Morty SRE: ```yaml
# FF rollback via feature-flag service
feature_flag: embedding_preview
action: disable
scope: global
reason: "emergency traffic-shape"
``` 
Morty SRE: flag disabled across regions.
Samir Patel: Nice. Lia, can you also enable KV-prefix caching for repeated requests pattern? That should cut those redundant tokens.
Lia Chen: Enabled prefix cache for embeddings route; config pushed to runtime pool-3: `prefix_cache: enabled, ttl=60s`.
Jen Lee: Current numbers: eu-west 429 -> 6.2%, 503 -> 1.2%. total token throughput down 28%. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/embeddings/errors?from=1768801100
Mike O'Connor: Draft to customers (top affected): "We're mitigating an elevated error rate affecting embeddings. We've throttled high-volume keys and disabled a preview feature to stabilize service. No data loss expected; we'll follow up with ETA. Contact support@redwood if you see persistent errors." Want to send now or wait another 10m?
Samir Patel: wait 10m to see trend. if 429 < 5% we hold. notify account teams regardless.
Jen Lee: Setting a Datadog monitor to 10m sustained >10% 429 in any region -> auto-page. Also setting a notification to #eng-oncall and #support.
Morty SRE: Observability note: please collect sample logs for the 503s (stack traces) and upload to the incident thread. I've run `dd query` for the last 30m and attached a gist: https://internal.gist/emb503-samples
Jen Lee: No stack traces in 503 samples — backpressure / worker OOMs suspected earlier; runtime telemetry shows a brief increase in kernel wait on the embedding workers at 1768801250.
Lia Chen: I spun an extra worker pool (pool-emb-aux) and routed 10% of traffic to it as a safety valve. Routing changes applied via `rw-route shift`.
Lia Chen: ```sh
rw-route shift --service embeddings --from pool-emb-main --to pool-emb-aux --percent 10
``` 
Jen Lee: After aux pool: 503s down to 0.7%, 429s ~5.1%. still monitoring.
Samir Patel: Good. let's also schedule an immediate customer-impact assessment: rank affected tenants by error-rate and token loss probability. Mike, can you sync with account for the top 3?
Mike O'Connor: On it. pinged account reps and put the draft message in CRM. will escalate to legal/ops if any SLA hits.
Morty SRE: Small follow-up: added a temporary token bucket global cap for unauthenticated/batch clients to prevent runaway traffic. rule id rt-344.
Jen Lee: Confirming trending: 429 5m avg across all regions now 4.6%, 503 0.5%. alert threshold not hit. I recommend leaving throttles and flags in place for 30m and then slowly relax.
Samir Patel: Agreed. create a runbook snippet for the handoff.
Morty SRE: Handoff notes: mitigation actions taken - tenant throttles (acme-corp, streamly), disabled embedding_preview flag, enabled prefix caching, spun up aux pool, applied global token-bucket cap. Key artifacts: grafana links + dd gist. Checkpoints: metrics stable for 30m -> begin relaxation.
Mira Oncall: I'll take second-watch follow-up. ETA 30m to re-evaluate and remove soft-throttles if stable.
Samir Patel: Thanks Mira. final ask: Lia, keep the `rwctl` rule ids and command history in the incident ticket.
Lia Chen: added commands and rule ids to INC-2026-87.
Mike O'Connor: Sending account pings now (only to affected customers). DM thread with account leads in #customer-success.
Jen Lee: I'll keep the monitor on and will re-open paging if 429 > 10% for 10m. set a reminder to review mitigation in 30m.
Samir Patel: Closing live mitigation phase for now. follow-up action items: postmortem, traffic pattern analysis, tenant quota guidance, possible SDK backoff recommendation. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ticket INC-2026-87 updated. If metrics regress, page #eng-oncall again.
